Lisa's choir has 52 members. 50% are boys and 50% are girls, so there are 26 boys and 26 girls. The choir performs with just its female members, so there are 26 girls. On the day of the performance, half the people performing can't make it to the show, so 13 people can't make it. The choir's 3 teachers then decide to sing with them, so 26 - 13 = 13 girls perform, and the 3 teachers add to that, making 13 + 3 = 16 people. 

FINAL_ANSWER: 16
